EPS for Oracle Corporation (ORCL) Expected At $0.70
November 21, 2018 - By Jason Dias
Investors sentiment decreased to 0.82 in Q2 2018. Its down 0.05, from 0.87 in 2018Q1. It dived, as 73 investors sold Oracle Corporation shares while 564 reduced holdings. 107 funds opened positions while 414 raised stakes. 2.13 billion shares or 5.10% less from 2.24 billion shares in 2018Q1 were reported. Weitz Inv Mgmt holds 2.65% or 1.42M shares. Leisure Mgmt holds 0.46% or 12,316 shares in its portfolio. Drexel Morgan And holds 0.35% or 7,916 shares in its portfolio. Amarillo Bank & Trust holds 25,751 shares. Nj State Employees Deferred Compensation Plan holds 80,000 shares or 0.63% of its portfolio. Fisher Asset Mgmt Ltd Liability has invested 0.78% in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). Moreover, Van Hulzen Asset Management has 0.08% invested in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) for 5,929 shares. Endurance Wealth Mgmt holds 173,195 shares or 1.26% of its portfolio. Pzena Invest Limited holds 11.42 million shares. Nomura Holdings holds 0.09% or 676,432 shares. Ipswich Inv Management Company Inc holds 10,226 shares or 0.21% of its portfolio. Vantage Ltd Com has 9,830 shares for 0.11% of their portfolio. Bahl & Gaynor invested 0.02% of its portfolio in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). Benjamin F Edwards And Company reported 0.27% stake. Willow Creek Wealth Inc reported 8,051 shares.
Analysts expect Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) to report $0.70 EPS on December, 13.They anticipate $0.08 EPS change or 12.90 % from last quarter’s $0.62 EPS. ORCL’s profit would be $2.65 billion giving it 17.36 P/E if the $0.70 EPS is correct. After having $0.62 EPS previously, Oracle Corporation’s analysts see 12.90 % EPS growth. The stock increased 0.60% or $0.29 during the last trading session, reaching $48.62. About 13.86M shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has declined 6.50% since November 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.12% the S&P500. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) Ratings Coverage
Among 16 analysts covering Oracle ( NYSE:ORCL ), 6 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 10 Hold. Therefore 38% are positive. Oracle had 21 analyst reports since June 14, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Thursday, June 14 by JP Morgan. The stock has “Neutral” rating by Rosenblatt on Wednesday, June 20. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, June 20 by Bernstein. As per Wednesday, June 20, the company rating was maintained by UBS. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, June 20 by Cowen & Co. The firm has “Hold” rating by J.P. Morgan given on Thursday, June 14. Bank of America maintained it with “Neutral” rating and $55 target in Tuesday, September 18 report. The stock of Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has “Outperform” rating given on Thursday, June 28 by Raymond James. The stock has “Neutral” rating by Citigroup on Tuesday, September 18. The firm has “Hold” rating by Wedbush given on Wednesday, June 20.
Oracle Corporation develops, manufactures, markets, sells, hosts, and supports application, platform, and infrastructure technologies for information technology environments worldwide. The company has market cap of $184.20 billion. It provides services in three primary layers of the cloud: Software as a Service, Platform as a Service, and Infrastructure as a Service. It has a 51.29 P/E ratio. The firm licenses its Oracle Database software, which enables storage, retrieval, and manipulation of data; and Oracle Fusion Middleware software to build, deploy, secure, access, and integrate business applications, as well as automate their business processes.
